name: scientific-research-plugin
description: Research pipeline skills for OR / ML+OR / supply-chain researchers: survey, fetch, read, plot, polish, verify references, review, rebut, present.

plugins.name: scientific-research-plugin
plugins.description: A full-lifecycle research pipeline for OR & ML, 9 skills + 1 subagent take a project from prior-art survey to the conference talk — Zotero literature intake, structured reading notes, publication-grade figures, LaTeX polishing, citation verification against official APIs, three-blind adversarial review, and point-by-point rebuttal. The survey-first discipline applies to any non-trivial task, not just papers.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向运筹学与机器学习的全流程科研流水线：9 个技能 + 1 个子代理，把一个项目从先例调研一路带到会议汇报 PPT——Zotero 文献入库、结构化阅读笔记、论文出图、LaTeX 润色、官方 API 引文核查、三盲对抗审稿、逐条审稿回复。先调研后动手的纪律适用于任何非琐碎任务，不止论文。
